task_text: A typhoon is coming in 10 minutes. Seal up the house completely.

plans.R1:
```plaintext
[R1 - kitchen]
1. Close the window
2. Close the dishwasher
```
plans.R2:

2. Turn off the lights
plans.R3:

plans.R4:
[R4 - living_room]

2. Turn off the floor lamp to prevent electrical hazards.
plans.R5:
[R5 - bedroom]
1. Close the window blinds
2. Push the dresser against the window
plans.R6:
[R6 - bathroom]
1. Close the window
2. Close the other window
